hooks.name: derm-gate
hooks.description: derm policy gate: runs `derm hook gemini before` from derm's install folders through hooks/derm-gate.sh, never from PATH (rules case 227). Gemini lets a call through when a hook fails or times out, so the hook never crashes on purpose and caps its own waits at 90 seconds, below this timeout.

hooks.name: derm-record
hooks.description: derm records the call (a hash, no content) and redacts secret-like values in the result.
